[Image: A right-angle triangle. Segments PQ and RQ form a right angle and their lengths are 3 and 4 centimeters respectfully. Segment PR forms the hypotenuse and is 5 centimeters.]

Which of these is the reason that triangle PQR is a right angle triangle?
figure_description: A right triangle PQR with vertices shown as solid black dots. Vertex Q forms a right angle between vertical side PQ and horizontal side QR. Side PQ is on the left and has a length of 3 cm indicated by a double-headed vertical arrow. Side QR is along the bottom and has a length of 4 cm indicated by a double-headed horizontal arrow. The hypotenuse PR connects P at the top left to R at the bottom right, with a length of 5 cm indicated by a double-headed diagonal arrow.
